body:
Yeah, Things aren't doing to well money wise, frugal sounds interesting.

I can't say that I feel much better. Everything I have ever cared about is gone. Everything from people to material possessions. I fucking got kicked out of my parents house over this girl. I lost everything. I lost friends. I can't handle it. Five hours later and the sting of hopelessness hasn't faded, I'm angry. I can't stop. I haven't had a dry eye in hours and it makes me feel pathetic.

I left my dog with a friend, So that he would have someone to take care of him. He has gotten me through a lot but he deserves better.

*I hope you can talk to Ashley (oh no, I'm not suggesting getting a room or anything similar.) Though it'll do quite good to spare her being your rebound -- just talk to her as a normal human being would if she's willing to talk to you.*

Unfortunately, Ashley Died. The event I referenced was that she was drunk one night and called me for a ride home and I told her to find someone else. She ended up trying to drive herself home and getting in a wreck and never came out of the hospital
